certId.description: Opaque certificate management handle. Client-supplied verbatim or server-minted when absent. Stable across rotation (PUT). Max 63 chars; no path separators.

certPem.description: Leaf (server) certificate in PEM. Required on POST/PUT. Try-parsed as X.509 — malformed PEM is rejected with 400.

keyPem.description: Private key in PEM. Required on POST/PUT. Persisted 0600 (key-at-rest). Never returned on GET.

chainPem.description: Optional intermediate-chain PEM appended after the leaf.

hostnames.description: Output-only. SAN-DNS/CN auto-derived hostnames the certId registered into the SNI store. Ignored on POST/PUT.
